Completing specific missions grants 2 additional rotations each time, up to a maximum of 5.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Update Preview: Battle of Khalkhin Gol & Panel Update[/h2][p]Before October, we will release a new Soviet chapter: the [b]Battle of Khalkhin Gol[/b]. This chapter will include 3 levels with relatively low difficulty, serving as an introductory stage in Classic mode to help new players quickly learn gameplay mechanics such as controls and squad command.[/p][p]In October, we will also update the Encyclopedia panel, offering detailed information about squads, weapons, vehicles, and core game mechanics, which you can browse anytime.[/p][p]Looking ahead, Classic mode will continue to expand with more armies and missions, while Battlefield mode will see ongoing additions to its card pool and store items.[/p][h2]About "Classic Mode" and "Campaign Mode"[/h2][p]Our main development focus remains on "Campaign mode". notes.title: New Mode drops! New maps arrive! The China-Japan Battlefield is now live!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Dear Comrades,[/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! Thank you all for your love and support for The Patriotic War! Today, we bring you a major update, including a new mode and the China-Japan battlefield. Let’s dive into the new combat zones together! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Mode – Classic Mode Now Available[/b][/h2][h2][/h2][p]Classic Mode consists of multiple campaigns, each containing several levels. On the mission selection screen, players can configure various squad templates, adjusting personnel and equipment. After entering a mission, you can deploy pre-configured templates within deployment limits, freely combining troops and tactics to complete diverse combat objectives flexibly and secure victory for your army.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Classic Mode will be the focus of our future updates, with more campaigns and armies to be added.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40880063/b7f7de4efa259e3bc35ab3398808df9030494b08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Currently, Classic Mode includes a tutorial and 6 campaigns with a total of 13 levels[/b]：[/p][p][/p][h3][b]China Campaign:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Battle of Taierzhuang[/p][/*][*][p]Battle of Kunlun Pass[/p][/*][*][p]Hundred Regiments Offensive[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Soviet Campaign:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Battle of Stalingrad[/p][/*][*][p]Battle of Kursk[/p][/*][*][p]The Great Counteroffensive[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]New armies[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]The Chinese Army and Japanese Army are now available. They excel at building fortifications and assembling heavy weapons. notes.title: Summary of Major Update on April 27, 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]New Content Update[/h1]
[h2]New Faction – US Army[/h2]
[list]
[*] All Grand Battlefield maps now support the US Army faction! Players can freely choose to fight as the US Army.
[/list]
[h2]New Weapons and Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*] 18 new US light weapons, 15 vehicles, 7 heavy equipment, and 2 ground-attack aircraft.

[*] 2 new ground-attack aircraft and 1 new vehicle for the German Army.

[*] Convertible vehicles added: These vehicles have greater firepower and mobility but feature weaker armor, making them more vulnerable to HE and incendiary damage.

In campaign mode, attack aircraft remain AI-controlled and cannot be piloted by players.

[*] Attackers must break through the defenders’ lines before running out of reinforcements.

[*] Armor mode AI optimized for more mobile and group tactics.

[*] Campaign mode fully adapted to the new UI.
[*] Grand Battlefield shop interface further optimized.

[/list]

[*] Weather system fully upgraded, with new, more layered weather effects.
[*] Grand Battlefield values adjusted; challenge entries are now more difficult for increased challenge.
[*] Improved combat feedback in Grand Battlefield, with added effects for kills, currency gains, and more.
[*] Camera rendering optimized to improve visuals while reducing GPU usage by about 30%.

notes.title: Talk about remake campaign and updates for the battlefield mode
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support of "The Patriotic War". The game is currently participating in the Steam Spring Sale with a 30% discount. On this occasion, I would like to update you on our recent developments on behalf of TracerStudio.

We have put the updates for the campaign mode on hold, not because we underestimate its importance, but quite the contrary, we care more about it. We hope to make the campaign as exciting as the main quests in "Mount & Blade" and "Total War", allowing you to fully build your own team, develop your own troops, and engage in epic battles with passionate combat against enemies.

We are deeply aware of the current weaknesses and deficiencies in the campaign mode. The battles lack impressive presentation effects, the scale is not very large, and the casualties for players are overly harsh. Therefore, we are planning a complete reset of the campaign mode, which will not take very long, as we have already started this work. In the future, we will introduce major campaign lines for at least the Soviet, German, Chinese, and American forces, and we will strive to make each campaign line worth revisiting.

Of course, before that, we will release updates for the battlefield mode more quickly. In addition to content optimization, by May, we will launch the American forces, and allow each major battlefield level to choose its own faction, technological level, and attacker or defender. Before the 80th anniversary of Victory in World War II in August, we will launch the Chinese and Japanese forces, and at that time, unique weapons and equipment exclusive to the Chinese battlefield will be added.

If you like our game or are looking forward to our plans, please add it to your wishlist. We look forward to seeing you again!

notes.title: March 13, 2025 Major Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Battlefield Mode Experience Optimization![/b][/h2]
Reworked Infantry Mode AI Attack and Defense LogicWith adjustments to the level maps, the AI will now form clearer frontlines and adopt a variety of tactics for dynamic attack and defense, providing players with a more continuous and smoother combat experience.
Supply Center (Shop) RevampActive skills, consumables, and other items that were previously obtained through upgrades and disappeared upon death are now moved to the shop. Players can purchase these items at any time using support points. Additionally, a refresh function has been added to the Supply Center (Shop).
Dynamic Respawn Point Mechanism AddedPlayers can now respawn closer to the frontline, significantly reducing travel time. This ensures a smoother combat rhythm and an overall more enjoyable gameplay experience.

[h2][b]Shooting Experience Rework[/b][/h2]
Improved Gun Recoil FeedbackGun recoil will now directly affect the crosshair movement, allowing players to compensate for it (yes, you can control recoil now!).
Comprehensive Gun Stats AdjustmentTo match the new recoil system, all gun stats have been reworked, providing unique experiences for each weapon type. Bolt-action rifles: Increased damage but require longer aiming time. Submachine guns: Deadly at close range but with greater bullet spread at long distances. Machine guns: More stable when mounted but much harder to control when firing unmounted.

[h2][b]Mini-map Implemented![/b][/h2]
The long-awaited mini-map is finally here! The mini-map displays current mission objectives, player positions, and nearby friendly and enemy locations, helping players better assess the battlefield situation.

[h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2]
[h3]Battlefield Mode[/h3]
[*] Reworked AI commander troop deployment and attack/defense logic.
[*] Added an AI fallback mechanism when our base is under attack.
[*] Added an AI all-out assault mechanism when attacking the enemy base.
[*] Optimized AI behavior during stalemates to improve attack and defense routines.
[*] Improved AI behavior when building defensive structures.
[*] Simplified the mission system, reducing the frequency and number of side missions.
[*] Moved consumables and active skills previously obtained through upgrades to the Supply Center (Shop).
[*] Added a refresh function to the Supply Center (Shop).
[*] Significantly reduced player respawn costs, allowing more support points to be used in the Supply Center (Shop).
[*] Optimized target points and defensive structure placements in infantry assault missions.
[*] Introduced a dynamic respawn point mechanism.
[*] Adjusted the effects of certain skills.
[*] Introduced a new Conscript class to infantry assault levels and rebalanced attributes for various classes.
[*] KV-2 tank returns to the battlefield!

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[*] Added crosshair movement tied to recoil feedback and adjusted aiming speed. Different weapon types now have distinct handling characteristics.
[*] Comprehensive stat adjustments for all weapons, enhancing their strengths in their respective roles.
[*] Added 4 new weapons, expanding the German light weapon arsenal: VG 1-5, MP 28, MG 34 (saddle drum), MG 42 (belt-fed).

[h3]UI[/h3]
[*] Added a mini-map.
[*] Simplified squad marker UI.
[*] Improved various UI elements in Battlefield Mode.

[h3]Performance Optimization[/h3]
[*] Reduced performance costs for unit respawns, significantly minimizing frame drops during vehicle respawns.
[*] Optimized AI-related behaviors such as pathfinding and target acquisition to improve performance.
[*] Optimized UI elements like subtitles and squad markers to reduce performance impact.
[*] Improved resource loading logic, speeding up game loading times.

notes.title: Update announcement on January 28, 2025, Panzer Assault Mode is online!

January 28, 2025 Update Announcement:
0.74.001.7 has been released. Major update of the Battlefield mode, Panzer Assault mode launched!
·3 Panzer Assault stages and 4 Infantry Assault stages.
·Several brand-new maps.

notes.title: Panzer Assault mode is coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders!

Some time ago, we were forced to slow down the update efficiency due to some reasons. Now we have completed the construction of the new team, and we are now in a good state and returning to the formal project development with enthusiasm.

We're currently working on a new "Panzer Assault" mode where you'll lead your armored legion in thrilling tank battles with your enemies. At the same time, the original "big battlefield" mode will also be upgraded and optimized in an all-round way.

The new version will be released before Chinese New Year, so stay tuned!

notes.title: A Letter of Thanks from the Developers
notes.notes:
Hello PATRIOTIC WAR players and friends!

First of all, I sincerely thank you all for your love and support for PATRIOTIC WAR! Our game has been released for more than a month now, during this period, in addition to normal updates and maintenance, we are also thinking about the future development direction of the game and our team to bring you better quality game content.

Now, in order for PATRIOTIC WAR to realize upgrade breakthroughs and make more excellent gameplay and content, and for the studio to develop more good independent game works in the future, we decided to expand our development team and look for a more suitable offline office address. At the same time, we are also working on a series of maintenance and optimization of the underlying code to ensure the game's stability and smoothness, and to support our development of more new content.

As a result of these changes, the game's update rate has slowed down recently, and the rollout of some new features and fixes to existing issues may be slower than expected. We're already working hard to speed things up, it's just going to take a little more time, and we hope you'll understand and support us. When these efforts are finished, the game will return in an even better state!

Thanks again for your understanding and support.
PATRIOTIC WAR Production Team.

[*] Command System Upgrade

[olist][*] New radial quick-command feature: Hold the squad key or Alt to quickly select and issue various commands.
[*] Optimized the old command operations; no need to click the left mouse button to exit after issuing commands.
[*] Improved the command system framework to enhance the responsiveness and execution of commands.
[*] Added a feature for allied soldiers to follow the player.[/olist]
[list]
[*] AI Optimization
[/list]
[olist][*] Optimized soldier AI, focusing on behaviors when no specific vigilance direction is assigned.
[*] Player's soldier squads behave more rigorously and execute commands more efficiently.
[*] Campaign Improvements
[*] Fixed a bug that caused equipment information to continuously display.
[*] Resolved an issue where the item selection screen did not display the discounted cost.
[*] Added ammunition type descriptions to the vehicle details panel.
[*] Enhanced numerical comparison of weapons and vehicles. Comparison is automatically activated after selecting an item in the weapon selection interface and in the inventory, store/support panels.
[*] Adjusted the order of checks when soldiers earn titles. When multiple title unlock conditions are met simultaneously, the title with the higher difficulty to unlock will be prioritized.
[*] Fixed a potential blockage issue in the "Hunting the Panther" mission.[/olist]
[list]
[*] Miscellaneous Enhancements
[/list]
[olist][*] Adjusted the overheating parameters of some heavy machine guns to improve sustained firepower.
[*] Optimized certain buildings and obstacles to reduce the likelihood of AI getting stuck.
[*] Exploring new techniques and methods to lay the groundwork for future updates.
[*] Other detailed optimizations.
[/olist]

notes.title: The review of "The Patriotic War" has finally been passed!
notes.notes: Comrades! The review of "The Patriotic War" has finally been passed! It is confirmed that it will be officially launched on October 2 at 3 pm! This small ordeal did not frustrate us, and we will also grow through events one after another. Thank you to all the players for your long-term companionship. notes.title: We're sorry, but due to the STEAM audit, we're unable to release it on time for
notes.notes:
We're sorry to say that due to the STEAM review, we're unable to release the game on time for the time being. We can well understand your players' long expectation and wait for The Patriotic War. We're sorry that we misjudged the situation and caused the delay this time.
But we promise that as soon as the audit is passed, we will open the sale at the first time and share the battle with players and cheer the victory to come!
